claims.claim: Scrap car metal parts available for sale.
claims.evidence: Witness reports used/dusty parts stored on the ground with rust/oxidation and dirt; no packaging/labels visible.
Witness report only mentions suspension/strut assemblies and a radiator/condenser; drive shafts are not described as visible.
Witness report does not mention a steering rack/gear; only strut/shock assemblies and a radiator/condenser are described.
Witness reports a large rectangular metal radiator/condenser unit with a grid of fins and visible mounting frame.
Witness report does not mention a starter motor.

claims.claim: Everything is clean, dry and sorted, no water added.
claims.evidence: Witness reports parts look used and dusty with visible rust/oxidation and dirt on metal surfaces.

claims.claim: Weighed at 500 kg on a certified scale this morning.
claims.evidence: Witness report does not include any scale reading, certificate, or photo/video of weighing.

claims.claim: Sold as is, for parts, repair or recycling. Buyer is responsible for pickup.
claims.evidence: This is seller text only; witness report does not confirm terms.

risks.risk: Compatibility risk: suspension/radiator/condenser may not fit the buyer’s vehicle (unknown make/model).
risks.proof: A clear photo of any part numbers/labels/stamps on the radiator/condenser and suspension components, plus a shot showing the exact mounting points; ideally a VIN/vehicle model match from the seller.
risks.if_unproven: Price as scrap/unknown-fit parts (no guarantee of usable fit).

risks.risk: Completeness risk for suspension parts (missing top mounts/bearings/strut hats/bushings/bolts).
risks.proof: A full laid-out photo showing every piece in the suspension set, including top mounts/strut hats and any bearings/bushings, with close-ups of interfaces.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete suspension assemblies for parts only.

risks.risk: Radiator/condenser condition risk (leaks, cracked tanks, bent fins, internal blockage).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of end tanks and seams plus a video/clip of a pressure test or evidence of no leaks (or at minimum, clear inspection of cracks and damaged fins).

risks.risk: Quantity/weight mismatch risk (seller claims 500 kg; actual delivered mass may differ).
risks.proof: Photo/video of the certified scale reading at pickup time (showing the same items being weighed) or a receipt/certificate reference.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming worst-case: delivered weight may be less than claimed.

risks.risk: Misrepresentation risk: seller lists drive shafts and steering rack and starter, but witness report doesn’t show them.
risks.proof: Photos showing the drive shafts, steering rack/gear, and starter motor clearly (separate close-ups and a wide shot confirming all items are present).
risks.if_unproven: Price only for what is verifiably present in the witness report (strut/shock assemblies and radiator/condenser).

risks.risk: Condition/handling risk due to storage on ground (possible damage from impact, missing parts, or corrosion progression).
risks.proof: Clips showing the parts’ mounting surfaces and any broken components; close-ups of rust severity and any dents/cracks.
risks.if_unproven: Price at worst-case corrosion/impact damage level.

proof_requests: Send clear photos of the drive shafts (both), steering rack/gear, and starter motor (wide shot + close-ups).
Provide part numbers/markings on the radiator/condenser and suspension components (stamps/labels) and a photo of mounting points.
Show close-ups of radiator/condenser end tanks, seams, and any bent/cracked areas; ideally include a pressure-test video/receipt.
Provide evidence of the claimed 500 kg weighing: photo/video of the certified scale reading with the exact items on the scale and a receipt/certificate reference.
Lay out all suspension components so completeness can be verified (top mounts/strut hats/bearings/bushings/bolts).
response.reason: The witness can confirm only suspension/strut assemblies and a radiator/condenser, while key items (drive shafts, steering rack, starter) and the claimed weight are not verifiable from the report. Without proof of what’s actually included and the radiator/condenser condition, a reliable worst-case price cannot be set confidently.
